title: Weather and Hazard Route Planning
subtitle: Preparation is part of the route
summary: Storms, toxic fronts, radiation zones, and exposed ruins should change route decisions before they become emergencies.
body: Check warning text before leaving shelter. A route that is safe in calm weather can become a retreat problem during exposure.
Bring clean water, filters, food, and a return marker when moving near toxic or radiation markers.
Hazard markers in the first month are often warnings, not invitations. Log the intel and come back when counterplay is ready.
